notes.title: Upcoming update and trailer of our new game
notes.notes:
Hello! We have a lot of news!
Trailer of Our New Game
The first trailer of our new game Dungeon Forge is out!
Add the game to your wishlist, it’s very important for us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916470/Dungeon_Forge/
Liquor Store Simulator Update
Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about Liquor Store Simulator. Right now we are working on a big content update. There’s still a lot to do, but we can’t leave you without new content! In the coming days, we will release a small update, but we won’t say what it will include. Be patient — the wait won’t be long!

Also, a 31% discount on our game is active right now!

notes.title: v0.3.4p Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you all for your feedback and bug reports. We continue to improve the prologue and with this update we've made the following changes:


 Fixed an issue with saving licenses
 Fixed the display of prices in the price change window when starting a new save
 Fixed the display of the quantity of goods on shelves and in storage in purchase cards after reloading a save
 Fixed the update of interaction text for several objects (when changing language during gameplay)
 Added document highlighting during first interaction
